class.name: NNHTNMethod
class.brief_description: One strategy for accomplishing its parent [NNHTNCompoundTask].
class.description: Add as a child of an [NNHTNCompoundTask] to define a sequence (or partial order) of subtasks ([NNHTNTask], nested [NNHTNCompoundTask], [NNHTNSubtaskCall], or [NNHTNParallelTask]) that achieve the compound goal when this method's conditions hold. Use [member bindings] or [method on_resolve_arguments] to try alternative targets from world state (backtracking automatically if one fails), [member priority] to prefer this method under ranked planning, and [member ordering_mode] when subtasks can be reordered flexibly.

method.name: get_ordering_errors
method.description: Returns any invalid or cyclic [member NNHTNNodes.predecessors] errors under [constant PARTIAL_ORDER], or an empty array if valid.

method.name: get_ordering_warnings
method.description: Returns warnings for children that specify [member NNHTNNodes.predecessors] while [member ordering_mode] is [constant SEQUENTIAL].

method.name: on_get_priority
method.description: Optional planning hook returning a dynamic non-negative priority for this method under [constant NNHTNSearchSettings.RANKED] and [constant NNHTNSearchSettings.LOWEST_COST]. Overrides [member priority].

method.name: on_resolve_arguments
method.description: Optional planning hook returning an array of argument dictionaries to try in order as alternatives for this method.

members.member: World-state collection bindings that bind method arguments to candidate values (such as nearby items or enemies), trying each alternative in order.
Whether subtasks are planned strictly in scene order ([constant SEQUENTIAL]) or in any order satisfying their [member NNHTNNodes.predecessors] ([constant PARTIAL_ORDER]).

Non-negative preference score used by [constant NNHTNSearchSettings.RANKED] and [constant NNHTNSearchSettings.LOWEST_COST]. Higher priorities are tried first. Ignored if [method on_get_priority] is overridden.

constants.constant: Plans child subtasks strictly in scene order.
Allows the planner to try any valid topological ordering of subtasks that respects their [member NNHTNNodes.predecessors], backtracking across orders if needed.
